panels.title: Clusters up
panels.description: Clusters whose API answered on the last poll.

panels.title: Nodes down
panels.description: Nodes that did not answer the cluster-status request (total nodes minus nodes up).

panels.title: Critical alerts
panels.description: Open critical alerts (see alerts_lookback_days in the exporter config).

panels.title: Failed (last run)
panels.description: Protection groups whose most recent run failed.

panels.title: Cluster summary
panels.description: One row per cluster. Clusters that are down show only Status. Empty cells mean that collector failed (see cohesity_exporter_collector_success).

panels.title: Write throughput
panels.description: kNumBytesWritten (kBridgeClusterStats), 180 s max rollup, latest point per poll.

panels.title: Protection groups by last run status
Last run status (all selected clusters)
panels.description: Protection groups grouped by the status of their latest local backup run. NoRun = group has never run.

panels.title: Nodes down
panels.description: Total nodes minus nodes that answered the cluster-status request.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Status is UP when the node answered the cluster-status request.

title: Cohesity DataProtect - Multi-Cluster
description: Fleet and per-cluster view of Cohesity DataProtect clusters: storage, nodes, write throughput, last protection run status, alerts. Requires cohesity_exporter.
